subject: Vendr portal: privacy & scope assertion for Redwood inference services
messages:
From: Vendr Onboarding <onboarding@vendr.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Tara Singh <tara@vendr.com>
Date: 2027-10-07T09:12:00Z
Subject: Vendr portal access + initial evidence request

Hi Michael / Laura,

Thanks for the quick response during the intake call. We created a portal snapshot for Redwood and emailed an invite — you'll find it at the link below. To speed things up, we've pre-populated a CAIQ draft and a checklist of the most commonly requested artifacts (SOC 2 type II, CAIQ, encryption summaries, KMS attestation, and retention policies).

Portal link: https://vendr.whistic.com/portal/ABCD-1234
Portal invite: [Attachment: vendr-portal-invite.txt]
Checklist: [Attachment: vendr-sig-checklist.xlsx (Excel, 72KB)]

Could you confirm:
- Primary SSO admin (we support SAML/Okta)
- Scoped product surface: do you want the full Vendr product mapped or only the components we are using (Inference runtime + Console/API)?
- Any special evidence redactions we should be aware of for audit copies (PII, customer lists, etc.)

If you want us to fill a SIG-to-CAIQ mapping template, we can generate that and attach. ETA for CAIQ draft and SOC2 summary is end of day tomorrow if we have scope confirmed.

Best,
Tara Singh
Onboarding Manager, Vendr
[Attachment: vendr-sig-checklist.xlsx (Excel, 72KB)]

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Vendr Onboarding <onboarding@vendr.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-07T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Vendr portal access + initial evidence request

Thanks, Tara — appreciate the fast turnaround. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

1) Scope: please limit the CAIQ and evidence to the specific components we will consume: "Vendr Inference Runtime" and "Vendr Console / API". We do not need full-account telemetry or partner marketplace components documented. Narrow scope will help our compliance review.

2) SSO admin: please add Laura Bennett (laura.bennett@redwood.com) as the initial SAML admin. We'll confirm Okta metadata separately.

3) Evidence & redaction: Mina will own the evidence review and will flag anything that must be redacted prior to uploading to our portal. For now send the CAIQ draft and indicate which fields contain potential customer data so we can triage.

4) Retention and logs: please include a short statement in the CAIQ mapping about event/log retention windows (syslog, request traces) and where audit logs are stored (S3 region, retention TTL).

Attaching our intake note so you can map to our SIG subset: [Attachment: Redwood_Vendr_Onboarding_MAPlan.docx]

We'd like to have the CAIQ draft and SOC2 summary by EOD tomorrow if possible. If there are any blockers on sharing the SOC2 report, please provide a redacted summary with the auditor and control IDs referenced.

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Head of Platform Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Vendr_Onboarding_MAPlan.docx (Word, 48KB)]

On Thu, Oct 7, 2027 at 09:12 AM Vendr Onboarding <onboarding@vendr.com> wrote:
> Hi Michael / Laura,
> 
> Thanks for the quick response during the intake call. We created a portal snapshot for Redwood and emailed an invite...

From: Tara Singh <tara@vendr.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vendr Onboarding <onboarding@vendr.com>
Date: 2027-10-07T18:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Vendr portal access + initial evidence request

Michael / Laura — thanks for the clarifications. We've updated the portal to limit the CAIQ to the two components you specified and added Laura as SAML admin (pending acceptance). Notes and attachments below: 

- CAIQ mapping (scoped to Inference Runtime + Console): [Attachment: vendr-caiq-mapping.csv]
- SOC 2: redacted summary attached and auditor contact info included: [Attachment: soc2-2026-summary-redacted.pdf]
- Retention statement: included as a 1-paragraph control note in the mapping.

Quick answers to your questions:
- Auditor: Brightwater LLP (soc@brightwater.com) — contact listed in SOC2 summary.
- SOC2 coverage: our report lists subservice organizations; the mapping includes a reference column to indicate when control execution is dependent on a third party.
- Logs: request + diagnostic logs retained for 180 days in US-EAST-1 (S3) unless otherwise contracted.

Portal: https://vendr.whistic.com/portal/ABCD-1234 (you should have an invite link in your inbox).

If Laura accepts the SAML invite, we can run a short test flow tomorrow morning PST to ensure attribute mappings (email, groups) align with your Okta schema.

Best,
Tara Singh
Onboarding Manager, Vendr

[Attachment: vendr-caiq-mapping.csv (CSV, 14KB)]
[Attachment: soc2-2026-summary-redacted.pdf (PDF, 320KB)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara@vendr.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-08T15:34:00Z
Subject: Re: Vendr portal access + initial evidence request

Thanks, Tara — I confirmed receipt of the CAIQ mapping and SOC2 summary in the portal. A few quick asks to close our intake: 

- Can you confirm the SOC2 auditor point of contact for evidence requests (name + direct email)? Brightwater LLP contact in the PDF is generic; we need an auditor POC who can accept secure evidence transfer if required.
- Does the SOC2 report include explicit control IDs for encryption-at-rest (to map to our SIG #SC-16 encryption controls)? If not, please call out which control(s) describe encryption and where the evidence lives.
- Please add Laura as "Security Contact" in the portal (laura.bennett@redwood.com) so she gets ownership notifications.

Next steps on our side: 
- I'll run the CAIQ mapping against our SIG subset and return a delta list by EOD Friday (2027-10-10).
- If we need unredacted SOC2 pages we will coordinate a short NDA + secure FTP; I'll flag that in the delta list.

Thanks all — will keep you posted.

Mina Haddad
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none]
